verdict.rationale: Sill's docs say each iPhone or iPad pairs with the Mac once, and after that only paired devices can connect, over encrypted connections. Paired devices can be reviewed and revoked in Settings › Devices on the Mac or forgotten from the device. missing for 10: description of the pairing/approval step itself (e.g., code confirmation or an on-Mac prompt), clarity on USB pairing 'by themselves' without an explicit approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
